missing.tried: Internet Archive advancedsearch: title:(annals of real estate practice); creator:(national association of real estate); title:(code of ethics) 1913-1930; "real estate practice" 1923-1926; "national real estate journal". No period scan on IA. HathiTrust catalog search and babel full-text search both returned bot-gate pages from this environment. Lead: HathiTrust holds Annals of Real Estate Practice (1924/1925, full view) with the 1924 Code including Article 34; retry from a normal browser session.

chicagocovenants.com (home and /resources): documents live only inside an ArcGIS Experience viewer, no direct scan downloads, and the project site is not rights-cleared for reuse. Commons searches (Washington Park subdivision covenant, racially restrictive covenant Chicago) and IA advancedsearch ("washington park subdivision", "restrictive covenant" AND chicago) found nothing downloadable. No fabrication; needs a Cook County records pull or permission from the Chicago Covenants Project.

Commons and enwiki searches (Chicago Defender 1917/1919/front page/masthead; category Chicago Defender) and IA (title:(chicago defender); sim_chicago-defender*; texts 1915-1928). Found only a 1922 article clipping (1200px), a 1923 Joyland Park ad page (dcc-290339), a 1927 comic, and a 1948 front page (not PD-safe). Pre-1929 Defender front pages appear locked in ProQuest microfilm, which is rights-restricted. Not delivered.

LOC photos search kitchenette chicago (both pages), kitchenette family chicago, kitchenette interior. The April 1941 FSA Chicago kitchenette captions in LOC are exteriors and doorways by Edwin Rosskam; no interior captioned kitchenette surfaced. Delivered kitchenette-doorway-1941.jpg instead; Russell Lee interiors of the assignment exist under other captions and could be found with more search time.

LOC photo searches (fire world's fair 1894, peristyle fire, ruins). Best PD find was the morning-after engraving (delivered as white-city-fire-aftermath-1894.jpg). Also located IA vanishingfair00vanm (The Vanishing Fair, 1894) with halftone fire illustrations, leaf 18 shows the burning dome; usable as a follow-up if an illustration is acceptable.
No separate legend/title-block scan exists at Commons or Mapping Inequality; the legend is included on the delivered 13702x10816 full sheet and can be cropped losslessly.
